notes: Task 61 introduced no new BattleState, BattleCreatureState, HP, active-effect, ongoing-feature, or initiative durable field.
Initiative order and round advancement remain existing BattleState.initiative facts owned by the turn-boundary reducer.
Hit Points remain existing BattleCreatureState.hp facts owned by the Hit Point reducer.
Active Spell Effects remain existing BattleCreatureState.activeEffects facts owned by the active-effect lifecycle reducer.
Ongoing Feature occurrences remain existing BattleCreatureState.activeOngoingFeatureOccurrences facts owned by the ongoing-feature lifecycle reducer.
Same-timing order remains at the public turn-boundary hole/fill frontier; no fixture-local ordering ledger was added.
Route events are public reducer boundary projections derived from endTurn subject shape, active-effect kind shape, and typed holes/fills.
The route does not dispatch on authored spell identity, QNT branch names, witness field names, connector filenames, or fixture labels.
